contentText: RFK Jr. has just released new U.S. dietary guidelines, as part of the Trump administration’s “Make America Healthy Again” campaign. The national food pyramid has once again been reshaped, urging Americans to change their eating habits. But with shifting advice and political overtones, how effective are these guidelines? For expert insight, Eve Irvine welcomes Charlotte DEBEUGNY, a registered nutritionist based in Paris.
